# Task 2.1 synthetic reference cases

`cases.json` contains hand-calculated examples for a one-trip toy model. These are arithmetic references and boundary designs, not observations from a Philippine disaster plan. `one_trip_calibration` is the development example; the other two are arithmetic regression references under ADR-030. All were visible during development, so they provide no blind held-out or field validation. The v0.2 protocol pins their bytes and tolerances before Task 3.9 engine scoring; no external reviewer is required.
